en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, raising it, said,
‘There is no ritual more Beloved to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> than the Sa’ee, and that is because therein every tyrant is humbled’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad who in a marfu‘ manner has said the following: “He (the Imam) has said, ‘
No act of Hajj is more beloved to Allah than ‘Sa‘y’ because it humbles the tyrants.’”
